decks.notes: The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and card advantage. The deck aims to ramp up mana quickly with fetch lands and Abundant Growth, while utilizing powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six to control the board. The deck also includes powerful creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Ice-Fang Coatl to pressure the opponent. Yorion, Sky Nomad provides an extra advantage by flickering permanents for additional value. Overall, the deck aims to out-value and out-control the opponent to secure victory.

This deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures and disrupting the opponent's game plan with hand disruption and removal spells. It aims to apply pressure early on and maintain it throughout the game, utilizing powerful cards like Tarmogoyf, Ragavan, and Wrenn and Six. The inclusion of Urza's Saga provides additional value and threats, while the companion Jegantha offers a unique and powerful advantage. The deck's mana base is carefully crafted to support its three-color requirements while also including utility lands like Boseiju, Who Endures.

The deck focuses on ramping mana with cards like Arboreal Grazer and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove to quickly cast powerful spells like Scapeshift and Omnath, Locus of Creation. Control elements are provided by cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Supreme Verdict, allowing the player to disrupt the opponent's strategies while setting up their own win condition. Bring to Light allows for versatile spell selection, while Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle provides a potent late-game win condition. The deck aims to control the game until it can assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of powerful spells.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays that disrupt the opponent's strategy through hand disruption and removal spells, while also applying pressure with powerful creatures like Tarmogoyf and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. The deck also utilizes the land recursion abilities of cards like Wrenn and Six to maintain card advantage and ensure consistent land drops. The combination of efficient removal spells and strong threats aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent and secure a victory before they can stabilize their own game plan.

This deck focuses on assembling a variety of creatures with enter-the-battlefield or graveyard synergy to create a powerful combo. It utilizes cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician, Geralf's Messenger, and Blood Artist to create a loop of sacrificing, returning, and draining life from the opponent. The deck also includes various mana dorks like Birds of Paradise and Wall of Roots to ramp into its combo pieces quickly. With access to tutoring effects like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution, the deck can find the right creature toolbox pieces to win the game efficiently.

This toolbox deck revolves around utilizing various creatures to assemble combos and generate value. By leveraging the tutor effects of Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution, the deck aims to find key pieces such as Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide to create powerful synergies. With a mix of sacrifice outlets, undying creatures, and life drain effects, the deck can grind out incremental advantages while setting up game-winning combos. The toolbox approach allows for adaptability and flexibility in addressing various threats and situations.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo of Colossus Hammer, Puresteel Paladin, and Stoneforge Mystic to create a powerful, fast attacking creature. The deck uses equipment like Colossus Hammer and Kaldra Compleat to quickly deal lethal damage to the opponent. The addition of cards like Giver of Runes and Esper Sentinel provide protection and disruption to ensure the combo can go off smoothly. Urza's Saga provides additional tutoring to find key pieces of the combo. The deck aims to win the game quickly before the opponent can establish their own game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize various mill cards like Ruin Crab, Hedron Crab, and Fractured Sanity to quickly mill out your opponent's deck, while also controlling the board with cards like Fatal Push and Drown in the Loch. The inclusion of Tasha's Hideous Laughter can be a game-changer against certain decks, and Surgical Extraction helps to disrupt your opponent's strategy. The deck also includes some fetch lands and utility lands to ensure smooth mana base and consistent milling.

This deck focuses on quickly casting spells with cascade to create a powerful board presence and overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck can cascade into free or discounted spells. The deck also includes tempo plays with cards like Brazen Borrower and Bonecrusher Giant to keep the opponent on their heels. The goal is to flood the board with hard-hitting creatures like Crashing Footfalls while controlling the opponent's resources with counterspells like Force of Negation. The mana base is designed to support the deck's aggressive playstyle.

The deck focuses on utilizing creatures with various abilities to assemble powerful combos and disrupt opponents. By using cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Eldritch Evolution, the deck can search for specific creatures or sacrifice creatures for value. Magus of the Moon can disrupt opponents' mana bases, while cards like Strangleroot Geist and Geralf's Messenger provide aggressive threats. The toolbox nature of the deck allows for versatility in different matchups, with cards like Chord of Calling providing additional flexibility. It aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of speed, disruption, and synergy.

The main concept of this deck is to assemble the Colossus Hammer combo as quickly as possible to create a powerful threat on the board. By utilizing cards like Puresteel Paladin, Stoneforge Mystic, and Sigarda's Aid, the deck aims to equip Colossus Hammer onto a creature and deal massive amounts of damage in a single swing. The deck also includes protection cards like Giver of Runes and Shadowspear to ensure the equipped creature can't be easily removed. Overall, this deck focuses on efficient combo plays and aggressive strategies to overwhelm opponents.

The deck relies on cycling through cards to fill up the graveyard with cheap creatures, then casting Living End to return all creatures from the graveyard to the battlefield. This combo allows the player to quickly overwhelm their opponent with a massive board presence. Key cards like Street Wraith and Striped Riverwinder help cycle through the deck efficiently, while disruptive cards like Force of Negation and Grief provide protection and disruption. The deck aims to win quickly and decisively through its explosive combo potential.

The focus of this Merfolk Aggro deck is to quickly build a board presence with efficient creatures like Svyelun of Sea and Sky, Silvergill Adept, and Master of the Pearl Trident. Utilizing cards like Aether Vial and Force of Negation helps to maintain control and disrupt your opponent's strategy. By maximizing the synergy between Merfolk creatures and tribal support cards like Lord of Atlantis and Spreading Seas, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy. The inclusion of utility lands like Otawara, Soaring City and Waterlogged Grove gives the deck flexibility and consistency in its mana base.

This deck focuses on utilizing The Underworld Cookbook as a key engine for aggressive gameplay. It includes cards like Riddlesmith, Emry, Lurker of the Loch, and Reinforced Ronin to synergize with artifact cards and enable fast mana generation. Vengevine and Ovalchase Daredevil provide powerful threats on the board, while Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar and Ledger Shredder serve as disruptive elements. The inclusion of Mishra's Bauble and Urza's Saga further enhances card advantage and deck manipulation. With a combination of efficient creatures and artifact synergies, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly and maintain a strong aggressive presence.

The main concept of this deck is to apply quick and aggressive pressure on the opponent through fast and efficient creatures like Murktide Regent, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Dragon's Rage Channeler. The deck also features a high number of cheap and powerful spells to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan, such as Lightning Bolt, Counterspell, and Unholy Heat. Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration provide card advantage and selection while helping to fuel the graveyard for delve spells. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive game plan with plenty of early-game blue and red sources.

The main focus of this deck is to play aggressively by efficiently using cheap spells and creatures to pressure the opponent while disrupting their game plan with counterspells and removal. The deck utilizes a mix of prowess creatures like Ragavan and Dragon's Rage Channeler alongside powerful threats like Murktide Regent and Seasoned Pyromancer. The deck also includes cards like Blood Moon to disrupt opponent's mana base and Mishra's Bauble for card selection. Overall, the deck aims to tempo out opponents with a mix of aggressive creatures and disruption spells in the UR color combination.
